title: Meow platform grid
description: A hairline-topped section with a plain 32px title over a three-column grid of product cards: each card starts with its own hairline, a medium-weight name and a two-line description, then a pale-grey media panel; a line of small print can close each row. One column on phones.
notes: media: each card's panel (≈1.16 aspect) is a grey placeholder until filled
rows are groups of three cards, each with optional small print
